name: All-Star Movies Resort
desc: Movie-themed resort near Hollywood Studios. Most affordable tier.

name: All-Star Music Resort
desc: Music-themed resort with two large pools. Near Hollywood Studios.

name: All-Star Sports Resort
desc: Sports-themed budget resort. Great for families watching the wallet.

name: Pop Century Resort
desc: Retro pop-culture resort connected to EPCOT via Skyliner.

name: Art of Animation Resort
desc: Family-suite-heavy resort connected to EPCOT via Skyliner.

name: Caribbean Beach Resort
desc: Tropical resort connected to EPCOT and Hollywood Studios via Skyliner.

name: Port Orleans Resort – French Quarter
desc: New Orleans-style resort. Smaller and quieter than Riverside.

name: Port Orleans Resort – Riverside
desc: Sprawling bayou-themed resort with Royal Guest Rooms available.

name: Coronado Springs Resort
desc: Spanish colonial resort with a 15-story tower. Near Animal Kingdom.

name: Fort Wilderness Resort – Cabins
desc: Secluded log cabins sleeping up to 6. Unique setting near Magic Kingdom.

name: Grand Floridian Resort & Spa
desc: Disney's flagship Victorian resort. Monorail, steps from Magic Kingdom.

name: Polynesian Village Resort
desc: South Pacific-themed resort. Monorail and walking distance to Magic Kingdom.

name: Contemporary Resort
desc: Iconic A-frame resort. Monorail runs through the building. Walk to Magic Kingdom.

name: Wilderness Lodge
desc: Pacific Northwest-inspired lodge. Boat access to Magic Kingdom.

name: BoardWalk Inn
desc: Atlantic City-inspired resort. Walking distance to EPCOT and Hollywood Studios.

name: Beach Club Resort
desc: New England resort with Stormalong Bay pool. Walking distance to EPCOT.

name: Yacht Club Resort
desc: Nautical resort sharing Stormalong Bay with Beach Club. Walk to EPCOT.

name: Animal Kingdom Lodge
desc: African savanna resort with live animals viewable from rooms. Near Animal Kingdom.

name: Bay Lake Tower at Contemporary
desc: DVC tower connected to Contemporary. Monorail and walk to Magic Kingdom.

name: Boulder Ridge Villas at Wilderness Lodge
desc: Rustic DVC villas with access to Wilderness Lodge amenities.

name: Copper Creek Villas at Wilderness Lodge
desc: Modern DVC villas with plunge pools. Boat access to Magic Kingdom.

name: Grand Floridian Villas
desc: DVC villas at Disney's flagship resort. Monorail access to Magic Kingdom.

name: Old Key West Resort
desc: Disney's original DVC resort. Spacious Key West-inspired villas.

name: Polynesian Villas & Bungalows
desc: DVC studios and overwater bungalows. Monorail access to Magic Kingdom.

name: Riviera Resort
desc: European-inspired DVC resort. Skyliner to EPCOT and Hollywood Studios.

name: Saratoga Springs Resort & Spa
desc: Sprawling DVC resort near Disney Springs. Largest DVC property on property.

name: Treehouse Villas at Saratoga Springs
desc: Elevated three-bedroom villas in a wooded setting near Disney Springs.

name: Villas at Animal Kingdom Lodge – Jambo House
desc: DVC villas with savanna views. Access to Animal Kingdom Lodge amenities.

name: Villas at Animal Kingdom Lodge – Kidani Village
desc: Quieter DVC village with its own savanna and pool. Adjacent to Jambo House.

name: Walt Disney World Swan
desc: Marriott-operated deluxe hotel. Early Entry included — not eligible for Disney Dining Plan.

name: Walt Disney World Dolphin
desc: Marriott-operated deluxe hotel. Early Entry included — not eligible for Disney Dining Plan.

name: Walt Disney World Swan Reserve
desc: Autograph Collection hotel adjacent to Swan & Dolphin. Early Entry access.
